g.text: Participant key: gui = UsedCarGUI; form = PreparationForm; prepareCmd = PrepareEvaluationCommand; facade = UsedCarApplicationFacade; agent = UsedCarAgent.
session = EvaluationSession; checker = DataQualityChecker; panel = ListingAnalyzerPanel; llm = GeminiAdapter : LLMClient; parser = ResponseParser; worker = SwingWorker.
A2 partial drafts/conflicts are valid outputs; A3 invalid corrections or B2 stale baselines stop saving. confirmListing(..., false) also rejects approval at the API boundary.
Cancellation does not roll back prior/in-flight listingNeeds registration. Already sent requests may consume quota. Interrupted get() restores the interrupt flag.
Notation: filled arrow = synchronous call; open arrow = scheduling / user event; dashed = return / exception propagation. UI actions and framework callbacks are labelled explicitly.
Insert both landscape panels as Figure 3.3. Existing 4-inch placeholder is insufficient; insertion and scope verification are documented in UML-03-verification.md.
Cancel detaches worker and clears the local draft; done() ignores detached results.
NO never calls confirmListing. Saved Vehicle/preferences stay unchanged in both branches.
NO → confirm.test(review) is false; save() returns
[User answers NO to the A3 confirmation dialog]
[User clicks Cancel during analysis or draft review]
done(): get() throws ExecutionException; show cause message + no-save / explicit-retry advice.
Blank or >16000-character listings fail in PromptBuilder before the provider is called.
ref A1: exception through facade / command / worker
sd B3 — alternatives at A1/A2/A3 call sites; no automatic retry
Known-value disagreements are presented for explicit user choice, not silently merged.
throw IllegalStateException: saved vehicle changed; cancel and analyze again.
Return to A3 error handler; preserve the newer record.
No save and no automatic re-analysis.
sd B2 — reviewListing(r, v), called twice in A3
Any field / calculation rejection before commitment preserves the previous session. No Gemini request.
llmStatus() is local; no generateStructured / network call.
ref deterministic computation (details belong to SD02)
Parse and validate Vehicle, UserPreference, CostAssumptions;
vehicle(facade, values) reuses current ID or creates one.
Enter / edit fields; click Save and calculate
